annotations.title: Wallet portfolio: native, tokens, LP, staking, USD

description: One call for a wallet's balances with USD on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param). Polygon: native POL, every BlazarForce-list token (plus up to 20 extra tokens you pass), BlazarSwap LP positions with underlying amounts, BZB staking v1 (staked, earned) and staking v2 position, USD from the Blazar oracle. Base / Ethereum (chain param): native ETH plus the curated token list and your extra tokens, USD from DefiLlama. null = unknown, never guessed. Read-only.

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

tokens.description: Extra tokens beyond the chain's curated list (addresses or verified symbols).

items.description: Token to include: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.
